Root cause: admit_before_spawn commits the durable admission record before spawn_child runs (src/sase/tool/executor_run.py run_recorded_body), with fingerprint/env prep in between; two admitted records can therefore precede two child start stamps on a loaded host. Original failure run 7d9af4cef7ba6b82066e96437690602e shows assert 1 == 2 at tests/tool/test_admission_processes.py:290, never reaching _max_overlap. Fix: keep admitted/waiting waits, then _wait_for >=2 starter stamps followed by exact ==2 assertion with stamp diagnostics; no sleep, no timeout change, no retries. Preserves 42255c3cce nested-wait pattern and all real-process overlap checks.
